value: IN TILT SKILLET HEAT 1/2 CUPS OF OLIVE OIL UNTIL HOT
ADD ONIONS, CELERY AND CARROTS AND COOK UNTIL CARROTS ARE SOFT
ADD GARLIC AND SWEAT FOR ABOUT 30 SECONDS (UNTIL AROMATIC)
ADD DRIED HERBS AND SPICES AND MIX THOROUGHLY
ADD TOMATO PASTE TO TILT SKILLET AND LET COOK UNTIL BUBBLING
PUREE DICED TOMATO CANS WITH IMMERSION BLENDER AND ADD TO TILT SKILLET
FULL MIX ALL INGREDIENTS AND LOWER HEAT SO SAUCE COMES TO A SIMMER
SIMMER SAUCE ON LOW FOR 1 HOUR STIRRING OCCASIONALLY
REMOVE SAUCE FROM TILT SKILLET INTO 200 PANS TO COOL COMPLETELY
ONCE COOLED COMPLETELY, PACKAGE IN PROPER SIZED BAIN MARIE CATER WRAP AND LABEL FOR EVENT
